# `reverse`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a reversed string, a binary value with bytes in reverse order,
or an array with reverse order of elements.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
reverse(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `collection_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- reverse, example 1
> SELECT reverse('Spark SQL');
LQS krapS
```

```sql
-- reverse, example 2
> SELECT reverse(array(2, 1, 4, 3));
Error: DATATYPE_MISMATCH.UNEXPECTED_INPUT_TYPE
```

```sql
-- reverse, example 3
> SELECT hex(reverse(x'CAFE'));
FECA
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
